notes:
Inbound from doc-search landing page. Self-serve signup last week; trial credits used to run small POC. Primary contact: Aaron Li (Head of Platform). Key asks: embeddings + reranking workflow for customer-facing knowledge base; simple developer experience to plug into existing vector DB (they're experimenting with Pinecone & SQLite + open-source vector index).

Aaron: 'We need high precision for short answers (1-3 sentences) and a reranker to demote hallucinations.'

Shorthand from call (03/08):
- want hosted API (self-serve) first, likely stay on public cloud; may revisit Dedicated if usage grows >10k QPS tokens/month.
- embedding model preferences: high recall for 512-d vectors, asking about recommended Redwood embedding models and output dims.
- reranking: prefer two-stage (sparse/bm25 -> embedding search -> LLM rerank). Asking if Redwood supports reranking primitives or example pipelines.
- vector DB integration: Qs about latency between Redwood hosted API + external vector DB (round-trip cost), caching options, prefix/KV caching for short context.
- latency SLO: p50 < 120ms for rerank calls (they expect most calls small batch of 5 candidates), p95 < 350ms desirable.
- throughput: low currently (50-200 qps), cost sensitive (startup budget).
- security: SSO for admin UI is must-have later; SOC2 is nice-to-have.
- compliance: storing user queries for 30 days max, want ability to purge.

They ran basic evals vs Algolia + Pinecone prototypes — saw better recall with embedding approach but unstable ranking. Looking for guidance on model choice + rerank prompt templates.

AE notes: good demo fit for Hosted API; high chance to convert to paid self-serve if cost/perf works. Ask SE to prepare sample pipeline (hosted embeddings -> Pinecone/Weaviate sample code -> Redwood text generation reranker) and clear doc on token cost estimation.

Follow-up items (owner): quickstart + sample repo, latency estimates for typical flow, recommended embedding dims & batching guidance, checklist for SSO + audit log roadmap.
